LanguageData.RT_M2A3_Vehicle.label: M2A3 Bradley
LanguageData.RT_M2A3_Vehicle.description:
US Army IFV equipped with a 25mm M242 Bushmaster autocannon, twin TOW anti-tank missile launcher, and M240C coaxial MG.
<color=#bb8f04>Crew:</color> Driver x1, Commander x1, Gunner x1, Passenger x6 <color=#bb8f04>Fuel:</color> Chemfuel
<color=#b0e0e6>CE Ammo:</color> - 25mm M242 Bushmaster: 25x137mm NATO cartridge (HE / AP / Sabot) - BGM-71 TOW ATGM: BGM-71 TOW missile (HEAT) - 7.62mm M240C MG: 7.62x51mm NATO cartridge (FMJ / AP / HP)
